verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government migration and asylum service, so a public status lookup for an application or case is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only general information pages (migration, integration, asylum procedure, statistics) and service teams who answer questions. Nothing documents a public page where a user can check the status of their own filing or case.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
